description: Historical P1 14 positives had antecedents inside the moved clause; moving clause intact broke no discourse link.
impact: High false-positive rate on intra-clause discourse; contaminated evaluation.
remediation_evidence: Sentence positional analysis implemented; 10 cases converted to Hard Negatives (INTRA_CLAUSE_DISCOURSE_PRESERVATION).

description: Historical P2 14 positives lacked explicit antecedent ground truth; relied on assumed clause order.
impact: Unconfirmed defect ground truth; subjective evaluation.
remediation_evidence: Requirement of deterministic section mappings, character spans, and cross-clause boundaries enforced.

description: Zero strict verified positive examples existed in Phase 4D-C benchmark.
impact: No reliable positive ground truth to evaluate detector sensitivity.
remediation_evidence: Constructed 30 computationally verified positive cases with proven cross-clause dependency inversions.

description: Previously inspected SEC contract families were mischaracterized as an unexposed sealed test set.
impact: Violation of machine learning evaluation integrity; data leakage.
remediation_evidence: 100% of Phase 4D-D benchmark cases allocated strictly to 'development' with DEVELOPMENT_ONLY family eligibility.

description: Candidate C2 historical narrative reported underfitting (0 TP) while post-hoc table reported 100% recall.
impact: Reporting conflict between stored predictions and narrative reports.
remediation_evidence: Phase 4D-C-A table recomputed from raw CSVs with explicit NOT_ESTIMABLE conventions; narrative wording qualified.

description: SEC EDGAR third-party contract exhibits erroneously asserted to be public domain under 17 U.S.C. 105.
impact: Legally inaccurate copyright classification of private commercial agreements.
remediation_evidence: Reclassified all SEC EDGAR material as PUBLICLY_ACCESSIBLE_RIGHTS_UNDETERMINED under fair use research standards.

description: Moving 'Section X below' after Section X preserves numerical link but contradicts directional deictic marker.
impact: Legal tension between literal drafting error and substantive covenant resolution.
remediation_evidence: 4 ambiguous cases isolated in ambiguous_cases.csv and queued for legal expert adjudication.

description: Displacing provisions across intermediate subsections alters intra-article flow without inverting article head.
impact: Ambiguity regarding whether subsection disruption constitutes broken legal dependency.
remediation_evidence: 3 ambiguous cases isolated in ambiguous_cases.csv and queued for legal expert adjudication.
